name: AnkiMCP
description: Lets AI assistants review due Anki cards, create and edit notes, decks, media, and note types, and sync with AnkiWeb through a local MCP server, for learners who study with Anki.

skills.name: Review and Study
skills.description: Fetches due cards, presents them, records Again/Hard/Good/Easy ratings, and syncs with AnkiWeb.

skills.name: Note Management
skills.description: Searches, creates, updates, and deletes notes, with confirmation required before deletion.

skills.name: Deck Management
skills.description: Lists, creates, and inspects decks with study-queue statistics and moves cards between decks.

skills.name: Media Management
skills.description: Stores, retrieves, and deletes media files referenced by notes, including local files and URLs.

skills.name: Note Type Management
skills.description: Creates note types and updates their templates and styling, such as right-to-left card CSS.
